stem.text: Iodine has a higher melting point than chlorine.
What is the reason for this?

A.text: Iodine has stronger covalent bonds than chlorine.

B.text: Iodine molecules have stronger permanent dipoles than chlorine molecules.

C.text: Iodine is more volatile than chlorine.

D.text: Iodine has stronger instantaneous dipole–induced dipole forces than chlorine.
